description: This file contains PHP functions related to network data handling, including generating XML, HTML, and WML representations of network interface statistics, and interacts with global variables and external objects for data retrieval and formatting.

methods.name: xml_network
methods.description: Generates an XML string representing the network devices and their statistics.

methods.name: html_network
methods.description: Creates an HTML table displaying network device statistics, including device names, received bytes, sent bytes, errors, and drops.

methods.name: wml_network
methods.description: Produces a WML card with network device information formatted for mobile devices.
